title: Stand Up Paddle Board Rental
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Bay Breeze Paddle Adventures offers Stand Up Paddle Board (SUP), Kayak, and Jet Ski rentals to people of all ages and skill levels. SUP is a sport that originated in Hawaii and is an exciting way to explore the waters of Tampa Bay while admiring the sea life. Not only is it fun and exciting, it's also a great total body workout. For a more casual water sport experience we also offer single and tandem kayaks. Enjoy a thrill on the bay by renting your own personal watercraft, it'll be an adventure you won't forget!
